title: Exercise Preconditioning to Protect Against Dialysis-induced Cardiac Injury
official: Exercise Preconditioning to Protect Against Dialysis-induced Cardiac Injury in Hemodialysis Patients: a Randomized Controlled Trial
summary: The goal of this study is to determine what happens to the heart muscle contraction when people cycle before their hemodialysis treatment. Will pre-dialysis exercise protect the heart from a decrease in pumping of the heart muscle (called stunning) that can happen during hemodialysis. We will study whether pre-dialysis exercise decreases heart stunning, decreases the number and severity of symptoms commonly associated with hemodialysis, and other outcomes
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* must be on chronic hemodialysis for at least 3 months
* age 18 years or older
* willing and able to provide informed consent
* assessed to be safe and able to exercise by unit HD Nephrologist

Exclusion Criteria:

* regular vigorous exercise outside of hemodialysis
* over 79 years of age
* intradialytic exercise \< 3 months
* poor echogenicity
* acute coronary syndrome in the past 3 months
* unstable arrhythmia/angina
* shortness of breath at rest or with minimal activity
* symptomatic hypoglycemia (\>2x/week in the week prior to enrolment)
